company_name: British American Tobacco Industries p.l.c. Common Stock
title: BAT recognised as Integrated Reporting Leader at Workiva Amplify 2026
summary: BAT has been recognised with the Integrated Reporting Leader award at the 2026 Workiva Amplify Customer Awards.
body_markdown:
BAT has been recognised with the Integrated Reporting Leader award at the 2026 Workiva Amplify Customer Awards, celebrating the Company's leadership in bringing financial and sustainability reporting together within a single reporting platform.


By bringing financial and sustainability performance together within Workiva, BAT has established a connected reporting environment that supports collaboration, governance, assurance and disclosure across the organisation.


**Commenting on the achievement, David Booth, Chief Accountant Officer, said:**


*"Bringing our financial and sustainability reporting into a single governed environment has strengthened ease of transparency, consistency and control, reinforcing confidence in the robustness of our reporting processes."*


**Giulia Scanferla, Head of Sustainability Reporting & Indices, added:**


*"With a connected and governed reporting environment, we can provide comprehensive insights that support strategic decision-making and create greater value for our stakeholders."*


The award reflects BAT's continued focus on enhancing reporting capabilities and providing stakeholders with clear insights into how financial performance and sustainability priorities contribute to long-term value creation.
